reviews.text: Unfortunately, I have had a very disappointing experience with this pet health insurance plan. My dog, Millie, is 15 years old. What was particularly frustrating was that the price was increased without me being properly informed; I only became aware of the higher amount after I was charged. I also had a frustrating experience when I went to one of their clinics in Notting Hill because my dog needed medication. I was not given a clear response or follow-up, and I was unable to purchase the medication because I was told that my dog first needed to have a consultation for various reasons. I have cancelled the plan.

I found this clinic through a friend’s recommendation, and I couldn’t be more grateful. Dr. Gia Naciu was absolutely exceptional. You can immediately see how passionate she is about caring for animals, and that genuine dedication made all the difference.

After visiting several other clinics where the vets seemed uninterested and couldn’t identify what was wrong with my cat, Dr. Naciu finally helped us find the real problem. Her professionalism, attention to detail, and compassion gave me confidence from the very beginning.

I also really appreciated their honesty when it came to the cost of treatment. Instead of pushing the most expensive option, they took the time to discuss different alternatives and made sure we chose the best solution for both my cat and my budget.

I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for knowledgeable, caring, and trustworthy veterinary professionals. Thank you for giving my cat the care he truly deserved!

The care that my furry baby got at this practice was above and beyond🤩
It's indeed comforting and brings peace of mind to meet people who are truly passionate ,knowledgeable and empathetic .
Dr.Gia it's a star 🌟 always receptive and professional,thanks to her we got the appropriate treatment for our kitty.
Forever grateful to heroes who are looking after this little sweet creatures! 🐾

I had such a great experience at this clinic. It’s never easy taking a cat to the vet, but everyone made the visit as stress-free as possible.

Dr. Gia Naciu was amazing with my cat, so patient, gentle, and kind. She took the time to explain everything clearly and made me feel very reassured.

The receptionist was lovely and made changing vets after my move incredibly easy by helping arrange the transfer of my cat’s records. The nurse was also wonderful and very gentle when helping taking my cat’s blood test.

Everyone was friendly, caring, and professional. I’m so grateful for the excellent care my cat received and would highly recommend this clinic!

The staff at Virtue Vets Notting Hill have shown genuine care for my pet from the very first visit. They took the time to understand the issues, demonstrated excellent vet knowledge, and presented several treatment options.

The practice is modern, well-equipped, and offers a wide range of services, from dental care to physio. What I particularly appreciate is their honesty and consideration of treatment costs, where they take a sensible, incremental approach to diagnosis and treatment.

I wouldn't hesitate to recommend Virtue Vets to other pet owners.

An amazing experience.
Just walked in for some advice regarding some concern I had. I have received full response and genuine interest.
If I ever got own animal, definitely will visit you, others I recommend this place to All.

Thank you.

Motto
"Kindness don't cost anything"
Someone kindly handed in our cat and this vet took great care of him till we collected him.

After three years, we finally found a veterinary clinic and a doctor we are truly happy with. It feels so good to have a place where people really care and want to help our dog.
Dr. Gia Naciu is amazing. She always takes time to explain everything in a clear and simple way, which is very important for anxious pet owners like us. She is patient and never rushes the appointment, which makes a big difference. She also offers different options for treatment, so we can choose what works best for us and feel comfortable with the plan.
The nurses and the reception team are also very kind and polite. They are always friendly and ready to help, which makes every visit even more comfortable.
We feel much more confident and calm knowing our dog is in such good hands.

Amazing service from start to finish. The team is incredibly friendly and genuinely cares about the animals they treat. They’ve gone above and beyond to make sure my dog is well looked after and I always feel confident leaving him in their care. Highly recommended!
We always have a great experience with everyone at Virtue Vets! Luna our dog genuinely loves visiting and she gets all the support and attention each time which we really appreciate!

Absolutely love this vet. The location is modern and beautiful, and the entire team is incredibly welcoming and gentle with Bassie. You can tell they genuinely care about the animals and take their time to make them feel comfortable. Very professional throughout, and their pricing plans are clearly structured and fair. Highly recommend.

Incredible veterinary service in London. You can expect super compassionate and knowledgable staff, extremely thorough care, and a place where you and your pet feel supported, heard, and looked after. My dog is like my child (a 6.5 year old mini labradoodle) and I trust VV with his life, literally! Their membership plans are beyond worth it, HIGHLY recommend for any pet parent who cares about their pet's health. The annual teeth cleaning, monthly flea/tick/deworming, travel documents, and other membership perks make the monthly cost a no brainer. I've also found, in addition to the care being better, the costs are actually also better when compared to other vets like Medivet or Creature Comforts.

Amazing care! The vet, Jenny, and the veterinary nurse, Evie - were incredible today when I had to bring my puppy in without an appointment. Professional, compassionate & super efficient! They really take the time to explain everything and it makes such a difference! So happy I found this local veterinary practice, they truly care about your pet.
The team at Virtue vets in Notting Hill is amazing. Super informative and helpful from start to finish. I could not recommend them highly enough!
Lovely place with lovely vets! Take such good care of their animals. Super well kitted out. Highly recommend!

I had previous spoken with Gia regarding treatment of my older cat Pip. She was extremely helpful and today was his first visit and all went well. Gia and the nurse Evie were very helpful and professional.
I have signed up for the basic monthly healthcare plan which will definitely help with regards to costs and when I register my other cats I get a discount.  All good and highly recommended.

We’ve been with Virtue Vet since Bruno was just 8 weeks old, and I truly couldn’t wish for a better vet for him.  I always felt supported, listened to, and never rushed. The care here feels genuinely thoughtful and personal.

A very special thank you to Kiekie — she is honestly the person who keeps me sane when I worry about my puppy. She is always calm, kind, and in touch, and she knows exactly how to reassure me. Even when something turns out to be a behaviour issue, she communicates directly with our trainer so Bruno gets proper, well-rounded care. That means the world to me.

So grateful to the entire Virtue Vet team for taking such good care of Bruno and for taking such good care of me too 🤍 Highly recommend from the bottom of my heart.

My dog Bruno has seen Allison multiple times- he’s generally scared of the vet, but she’s so gentle, professional and kind. Always takes the time to explain what’s wrong and a plan going forwards. Only good things to say.
All the vets were amazing, took care of Agnes from start to finish. She rushed back in for her follow up appointments, which isn’t something dogs tend to do with the vets. Thanks again!

10/10 They took us on a last minute appointment to see Minnie. They were understanding and super helpful, they offer snacks for pets while they wait and the interiors are nice and comfortable. They also offered us tea whilst Minnie was getting treatment.

They were caring and the most important human ❤️ they understand how much you love your pets.

Thank you ❤️
